title.zh: 卷二十 本紀第二十: 興宗三
title.raw: 卷二十 本紀第二十: 興宗三 Volume 20 Annals 20: Xingzong 3

sentences.zh: 興宗三

translations.literal: Xingzong, Part Three
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong, Part Three

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月己卯，如混同江。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, spring, first month, on jimao day, the court went to the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, on jimao day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，如魚兒濼。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengshen day, went to Yuer Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day of the second month the court went to Yuer Marsh.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，禁群臣遇宴樂奏請私事。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, forbidden officials at banquets and entertainments to present memorials on private affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day officials were forbidden at banquets and entertainments to present memorials on private affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔世選之官，從各部耆舊擇材能者用之。

translations.literal: Edict ordered that hereditary-selection offices employ the capable chosen from elders of each tribe.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that hereditary-selection offices employ the capable chosen from elders of each tribe.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，如黑水濼。

translations.literal: Third month, on dinghai day, went to Heishui Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day of the third month the court went to Heishui Marsh.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，遣使審決雙州囚。

translations.literal: On guisi day, dispatched envoys to review and decide prisoners in Shuang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day envoys were dispatched to review and decide prisoners in Shuang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大雪。

translations.literal: On renyin day, heavy snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳朔，皇太不豫，上馳往視疾。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yisi new moon, the Empress Dowager fell ill; the Emperor galloped to visit her.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi new moon of the fourth summer month the Empress Dowager fell ill, and the Emperor galloped to visit her.

sentences.zh: 丙午，皇太后愈，復如黑水濼。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the Empress Dowager recovered; the court again went to Heishui Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Empress Dowager recovered, and the court again went to Heishui Marsh.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，肆赦。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，清暑永安山。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wushen day, summered at Yongan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day of the sixth month the court summered at Yongan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，阻卜大王屯禿古斯來朝，獻方物。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Zubu great king Tutugu came to court and presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Zubu great king Tutugu came to court and presented local products.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔士庶言事。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, edict ordered commoners and gentry to submit memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict ordered commoners and gentry to submit memorials.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，幸慶州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinmao day, visited Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day of the seventh autumn month the court visited Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 自是月至於九月，日射獵於楚不溝霞列、系輪、石塔諸山。

translations.literal: From this month until the ninth month, daily hunted at Chubu Gou Xialie, Xilun, Shita, and other mountains.
translations.idiomatic: From this month until the ninth month the court hunted daily at Chubu Gou Xialie, Xilun, Shita, and other mountains.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，幸中京，謁祖廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinhai day, visited the Central Capital and paid respects at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the tenth winter month the court visited the Central Capital and paid respects at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，定公主行婦禮於舅姑儀。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, fixed the ritual for princesses performing daughter-in-law rites toward parents-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the ritual was fixed for princesses performing daughter-in-law rites toward parents-in-law.

sentences.zh: 庚午，鐵驪仙門來朝，以始入貢，加右監門衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Tieli Xianmen came to court; because this was his first tribute, he was promoted to Right Defender of the Gate Commandant grand general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Tieli Xianmen came to court; because this was his first tribute, he was promoted to Right Defender of the Gate Commandant grand general.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，祠木葉山。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on wuyin day, sacrificed at Muye Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day of the eleventh month sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幸中京，朝皇太后。

translations.literal: On jichou day, visited the Central Capital and attended upon the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the court visited the Central Capital and attended upon the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，禁漏泄宮中事。

translations.literal: On renchen day, forbidden leaking palace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day leaking palace affairs was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑朔，女直遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on xinchou new moon, Jurchen dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the twelfth month Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，謁太祖廟，觀《太宗收晉圖》。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, paid respects at Taizu's temple and viewed the painting 《Taizong's Recovery of Jin》.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple and viewed the painting 《Taizong's Recovery of Jin》.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，問安皇太后。

translations.literal: On guichou day, inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Emperor inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以太后愈，雜犯死罪減一等論，徒以下免。

translations.literal: On yimao day, because the Empress Dowager had recovered, mixed offenses of capital crime were reduced one degree in punishment, and those at convict labor and below were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, because the Empress Dowager had recovered, mixed offenses of capital crime were reduced one degree in punishment, and those at convict labor and below were exempted.

sentences.zh: 庚申，南府宰相杜防、韓紹榮奏事有誤，各以大杖決之。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Southern Court chancellor Du Fang and Han Shaorong erred in memorializing; each was punished with the great staff.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Southern Court chancellor Du Fang and Han Shaorong erred in memorializing, and each was punished with the great staff.

sentences.zh: 出防為武定軍節度使。

translations.literal: Fang was dismissed and made military commissioner of Wuding Army.
translations.idiomatic: Fang was dismissed and made military commissioner of Wuding Army.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月丁亥，如春水。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, spring, first month, on dinghai day, went to spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, on dinghai day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸丑，射虎於候裏吉。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on guichou day, shot tigers at Houliji.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on guichou day, tigers were shot at Houliji.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，振瑤穩、嘲穩部。

translations.literal: Second month, on xinsi day, relief given to the Yaowen and Chaowen tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day of the second month relief was given to the Yaowen and Chaowen tribes.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔士庶言國家利便，不得及己事，奴婢所見，許白其主，不得自陳。

translations.literal: That month, edict ordered commoners and gentry to speak on what benefited the state; they must not touch their own affairs; what slaves and maidservants saw, they might report to their masters but must not present it themselves.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict ordered commoners and gentry to speak on what benefited the state; they must not touch their own affairs; what slaves and maidservants saw, they might report to their masters but must not present it themselves.

sentences.zh: 夏國王李元昊薨，其子諒祚遣使來告，即遣永興宮使耶律裏、右護衛太保耶律興老、將作少監王全慰奠。

translations.literal: Xia State king Li Yuanhao died; his son Liangzuo dispatched envoys to announce it; the court immediately dispatched Yongxing Palace commissioner Yelü Li, Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Yelü Xinglao, and Director of Works junior supervisor Wang Quan to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: Xia State king Li Yuanhao died; his son Liangzuo sent envoys to announce it; the court immediately dispatched Yongxing Palace commissioner Yelü Li, Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Yelü Xinglao, and Director of Works junior supervisor Wang Quan to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，以同知南京留守事蕭塔烈葛為左夷離畢，知右夷離畢事唐古為右夷離畢。

translations.literal: Third month, on guimao day, made associate regent of Nanjing Xiao Taliege Left yilibi and Tanggu, who administered Right yilibi affairs, Right yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day of the third month associate regent of Nanjing Xiao Taliege was made Left yilibi and Tanggu, who administered Right yilibi affairs, was made Right yilibi.

sentences.zh: 丙午，夏國李諒祚遣使上其父元昊遺物。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys presenting his father Yuanhao's bequeathed goods.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys presenting his father Yuanhao's bequeathed goods.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，鐵不得國使來，乞以本部軍助攻夏國，不許。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Tiebudei State envoys came requesting to attack Xia State with their tribal army; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Tiebudei State envoys came requesting to attack Xia State with their tribal army; permission was refused.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，武定軍節度使杜防復為南府宰相。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinwei day, Wuding Army military commissioner Du Fang again became Southern Court chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day of the fourth summer month Wuding Army military commissioner Du Fang again became Southern Court chancellor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲申，蒲盧毛朵部大王蒲輦以造舟人來獻。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Pulumaoduo tribe great king Pujian presented shipwrights.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Pulumaoduo tribe great king Pujian presented shipwrights.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，阻卜獻馬、駝二萬。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengchen day, Zubu presented twenty thousand horses and camels.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day of the sixth month Zubu presented twenty thousand horses and camels.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，長白山太師柴葛、回跋部太師撒剌都來貢方物。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Changbai Mountain grand preceptor Chaige and Huiba tribe grand preceptor Saladu came with tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Changbai Mountain grand preceptor Chaige and Huiba tribe grand preceptor Saladu came with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，於越摩梅欲之子不葛一及婆離八部夷離堇虎<番去>等內附。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dingwei day, Boge, son of yuyue Momoyi, and Balu Eight Tribes' yilijin Hugu and others came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day of the seventh autumn month Boge, son of yuyue Momoyi, and Balu Eight Tribes' yilijin Hugu and others came to submit.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，錄囚，減雜犯死罪。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, reviewed prisoners and reduced mixed offenses of capital crime.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day prisoners were reviewed and mixed offenses of capital crime were reduced.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，復南京貧戶租稅。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingxu day, again remitted rent and tax for Nanjing's poor households.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the eighth month rent and tax for Nanjing's poor households was again remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以殿前都點檢耶律義先為行軍都部署，忠順軍節度使夏行美副部署，東北面詳穩耶律朮者為監軍，伐蒲奴裏酋陶得裏。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, made Palace Front commander Yelü Yixian campaign army supreme commander, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xia Xingmei deputy commander, and Northeastern detail-stable Yelü Muzhe army supervisor to attack Puniuli chieftain Taodeli.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Palace Front commander Yelü Yixian was made campaign army supreme commander, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xia Xingmei deputy commander, and Northeastern detail-stable Yelü Muzhe army supervisor to attack Puniuli chieftain Taodeli.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，南院大王耶律韓八薨。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiashen day, Southern Court great king Yelü Hanba died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day of the tenth winter month Southern Court great king Yelü Hanba died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，駐蹕獨盧金。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, halted at Dulujin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the court halted at Dulujin.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未朔，遣使括馬。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei new moon, dispatched envoys to register horses.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei new moon of the eleventh month envoys were dispatched to register horses.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賜皇太弟重元金券。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, granted the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan was granted a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 封皇子和魯斡為越王，阿璉許王，忠順軍節度使謝家奴陳王，西京留守貼不漢王，惕隱旅墳遼西郡王，行宮都部署別古得柳城郡王，奉陵軍節度使侯古饒樂郡王，安定郡王涅魯古進封楚王。

translations.literal: Enfeoffed imperial sons: Heluwo as Prince of Yue, Alian as Prince of Xu, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xiejianu as Prince of Chen, Western Capital regent Tiebu as Prince of Han, tiyin Lüfen as Prince of Liaoxi, mobile palace deployment director Biegu as Prince of Liucheng, and Fengling Army military commissioner Hougu as Prince of Raole; Prince of Anding Nielugu was advanced to Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial sons were enfeoffed: Heluwo as Prince of Yue, Alian as Prince of Xu, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xiejianu as Prince of Chen, Western Capital regent Tiebu as Prince of Han, tiyin Lüfen as Prince of Liaoxi, mobile palace deployment director Biegu as Prince of Liucheng, and Fengling Army military commissioner Hougu as Prince of Raole; Prince of Anding Nielugu was advanced to Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月甲午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, spring, first month, on jiawu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, on the jiawu new moon of the first spring month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，留夏國賀正使不遣。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, detained Xia State envoys congratulating the New Year without sending them back.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Xia State envoys congratulating the New Year were detained without being sent back.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遣北院樞密副使蕭惟信以伐夏告宋。

translations.literal: On jihai day, dispatched Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin to inform Song of the campaign against Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin was dispatched to inform Song of the campaign against Xia.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，錄囚。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，如鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，獵霸特山。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, hunted at Bate Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the court hunted at Bate Mountain.

sentences.zh: 耶律義先奏蒲奴裏捷。

translations.literal: Yelü Yixian memorialized victory over Puniuli.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Yixian memorialized victory over Puniuli.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，幸燕趙國王洪基帳視疾。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengchen day, visited Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji's tent to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day of the second month the court visited Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji's tent to inquire after his illness.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，耶律義先等執陶得裏以獻。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Yelü Yixian and others presented the captured Taodeli.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Yelü Yixian and others presented the captured Taodeli.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，高昌國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Third month, on yisi day, Gaochang dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day of the third month Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以洪基疾愈，赦雜犯死罪以下。

translations.literal: On renzi day, because Hongji's illness had recovered, amnesty for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, because Hongji's illness had recovered, amnesty was granted for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，烏古遣使送款。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Wugu dispatched envoys submitting allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Wugu sent envoys submitting allegiance.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，以南府宰相耶律高十為南京統軍使。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guiyou day, made Southern Court chancellor Yelü Gaoshi Nanjing supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the fourth summer month Southern Court chancellor Yelü Gaoshi was made Nanjing supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰，五國酋長各率其部來附。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiachen day, chieftains of the Five States each led their tribes to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day of the fifth month chieftains of the Five States each led their tribes to submit.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，回跋部長兀叠臺紥等來朝。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Huiba tribal chief Wudietai Zha and others came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Huiba tribal chief Wudietai Zha and others came to court.

sentences.zh: 戊午，五國節度使耶律仙童以降烏古叛人，授左監門衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Five States military commissioner Yelü Xiantong, for surrendering Wugu rebels, was appointed Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Five States military commissioner Yelü Xiantong, for surrendering Wugu rebels, was appointed Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌朔，以韓國王蕭惠為河南道行軍都統，趙王蕭孝友、漢王貼不副之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renxu new moon, made Prince of Han Xiao Hui Henan Route campaign supreme commander, with Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou and Prince of Han Tiebu as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu new moon of the sixth month Prince of Han Xiao Hui was made Henan Route campaign supreme commander, with Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou and Prince of Han Tiebu as deputies.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，錄囚。

translations.literal: On chou day, reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On chou day prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，行十二神纛禮。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, performed the ritual of the twelve spirit banners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the ritual of the twelve spirit banners was performed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，宋以遼師伐夏，遣錢逸致贐禮。

translations.literal: On jisi day, because Liao troops attacked Xia, Song dispatched Qian Yi with condolence gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, because Liao troops attacked Xia, Song sent Qian Yi with condolence gifts.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，阻卜來貢馬、駝、珍玩。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Zubu presented horses, camels, and precious curios.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Zubu presented horses, camels, and precious curios.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，夏國使來貢，留之不遣。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Xia State envoys came with tribute and were detained without being sent back.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Xia State envoys came with tribute and were detained without being sent back.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，行再生禮。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, performed the rebirth ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the rebirth ritual was performed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，親征。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuxu day, the Emperor personally campaigned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day of the seventh autumn month the Emperor personally campaigned.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉朔，渡河。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on xinyou new moon, crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou new moon of the eighth month the army crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 夏人遁，乃還。

translations.literal: Xia troops fled, and the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: Xia troops fled, and the army returned.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未，蕭惠等為夏人所敗。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on dingwei day, Xiao Hui and others were defeated by Xia troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day of the ninth month Xiao Hui and others were defeated by Xia troops.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，北道行軍都統耶律敵魯古率阻卜諸軍至賀蘭山，獲李元昊妻及其官僚家屬，遇夏人三千來戰，殪之；

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, Northern Route campaign supreme commander Yelü Dilugu led Zubu armies to Helan Mountain, captured Li Yuanhao's wife and his officials' families; when three thousand Xia troops came to fight, they were annihilated;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Northern Route campaign supreme commander Yelü Dilugu led Zubu armies to Helan Mountain, captured Li Yuanhao's wife and his officials' families; when three thousand Xia troops came to fight, they were annihilated;

sentences.zh: 烏古敵烈部都詳穩蕭慈氏奴、南克耶律斡裏死焉。

translations.literal: Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Xiao Cishinu and Nankge Yelü Wol died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Xiao Cishinu and Nankge Yelü Wol died in battle.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，慶陵林木火。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on wuyin day, trees at Qing Mausoleum caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day of the twelfth month trees at Qing Mausoleum caught fire.

sentences.zh: 己卯，錄囚。

translations.literal: On jimao day, reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 有弟從兄為強盜者，兄弟俱無子，特原其弟。

translations.literal: There was a case of a younger brother and a cousin elder brother who were bandits; both brothers were without sons, and the younger brother was specially pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: There was a case of a younger brother and a cousin elder brother who were bandits; both brothers were without sons, and the younger brother was specially pardoned.

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月庚寅，僧惠鑒加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, spring, first month, on gengyin day, monk Huijian was promoted acting Grand Master of Inspection.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, on gengyin day of the first spring month monk Huijian was promoted acting Grand Master of Inspection.

sentences.zh: 庚子，耶律敵魯古復封漆水郡王，諸將校及阻卜等部酋長各進爵有差。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Yelü Dilugu was again enfeoffed Prince of Qishui; various generals and Zubu tribal chieftains each advanced in rank by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Yelü Dilugu was again enfeoffed Prince of Qishui; various generals and Zubu tribal chieftains each advanced in rank by degree.

sentences.zh: 贈蕭慈氏奴同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Posthumously honored Xiao Cishinu as Associate Councilor of State.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Cishinu was posthumously honored as Associate Councilor of State.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣使問罪於夏國。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, dispatched envoys to demand accountability from Xia State.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day envoys were dispatched to demand accountability from Xia State.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，如魚兒濼。

translations.literal: On renyin day, went to Yuer Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the court went to Yuer Marsh.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，夏將窪普、猥貨、乙靈紀等來攻金肅城，南面林牙耶律高家奴等破之。

translations.literal: Second month, on dinghai day, Xia generals Wapu, Wohe, and Yilingji attacked Jinsu City; Southern Court linya Yelü Gaojianu and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day of the second month Xia generals Wapu, Wohe, and Yilingji attacked Jinsu City; Southern Court linya Yelü Gaojianu and others defeated them.

sentences.zh: 窪普被創遁去，殺猥貨、乙靈紀。

translations.literal: Wapu was wounded and fled; Wohe and Yilingji were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Wapu was wounded and fled; Wohe and Yilingji were killed.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，殿前都點檢蕭叠裏得與夏戰於三角川，敗之。

translations.literal: Third month, on wuxu day, Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide fought Xia at Sanjiao River and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day of the third month Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide fought Xia at Sanjiao River and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命西南招討使蕭蒲奴、北院大王宜新、林牙蕭撒抹等帥師伐夏，以行宮都部署別古得監戰。

translations.literal: On guimao day, ordered Southwest pacification commissioner Xiao Punu, Northern Court great king Yixin, linya Xiao Samo, and others to lead troops against Xia, with mobile palace deployment director Biegu supervising the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Southwest pacification commissioner Xiao Punu, Northern Court great king Yixin, linya Xiao Samo, and others were ordered to lead troops against Xia, with mobile palace deployment director Biegu supervising the campaign.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣同知北院樞密使蕭革按軍邊城，以為聲援。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, dispatched associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge to inspect troops at the border cities as a supporting force.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge was dispatched to inspect troops at the border cities as a supporting force.

sentences.zh: 己酉，駐蹕息雞澱。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, halted at Xijidian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the court halted at Xijidian.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，幸殿前都點檢蕭叠裏得、駙馬都尉蕭胡睹帳視疾。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, visited Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide and imperial son-in-law Xiao Hudu's tents to inquire after their illnesses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the court visited Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide and imperial son-in-law Xiao Hudu's tents to inquire after their illnesses.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，如魚兒濼。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingyin day, went to Yuer Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day of the fourth summer month the court went to Yuer Marsh.

sentences.zh: 壬申，蒲盧毛朵部惕隱信篤來貢。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Pulumaoduo tribe tiyin Xindu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Pulumaoduo tribe tiyin Xindu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲申，高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，如涼陘。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jichou day, went to Liang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day of the fifth month the court went to Liang Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，蕭蒲奴等入夏境，不與敵遇，縱軍俘掠而還。

translations.literal: On guisi day, Xiao Punu and others entered Xia territory, met no enemy, and returned after letting the army plunder freely.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Xiao Punu and others entered Xia territory, met no enemy, and returned after letting the army plunder freely.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，夏國窪普來降。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Xia State's Wapu came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Xia State's Wapu came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遠夷拔思母部遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On jihai day, distant Yi of the Basimu tribe dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day distant Yi of the Basimu tribe sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰朔，置倒塌嶺都監。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingchen new moon, established the Daotaoling inspector-general.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the sixth month the Daotaoling inspector-general was established.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，謁慶陵。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 庚午，幸慶州，謁大安殿。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, visited Qing Prefecture and paid respects at the Great Peace Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the court visited Qing Prefecture and paid respects at the Great Peace Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔醫卜屠販、奴隸及倍父母或犯事逃亡者，不得舉進士。

translations.literal: On renshen day, edict forbade physicians, diviners, butchers, peddlers, slaves, and those who had served as substitute parents or fled after offenses from taking the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day an edict forbade physicians, diviners, butchers, peddlers, slaves, and those who had served as substitute parents or fled after offenses from taking the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 回跋、曷蘇館、蒲盧毛朵部各遣使貢馬。

translations.literal: Huiba, Hesuguan, and Pulumaoduo tribes each dispatched envoys presenting horses.
translations.idiomatic: Huiba, Hesuguan, and Pulumaoduo tribes each sent envoys presenting horses.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，宋遣使來賀伐夏捷，高麗使俱至。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Song dispatched envoys to congratulate the victory over Xia; Goryeo envoys also arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Song sent envoys to congratulate the victory over Xia; Goryeo envoys also arrived.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，禦金鑾殿試進士。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, held the jinshi examination in the Golden Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the jinshi examination was held in the Golden Hall.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，駐蹕括裏蒲碗。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renchen day, halted at Kuolipuwan.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the seventh autumn month the court halted at Kuolipuwan.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以燕趙國王洪基領北南樞密院。

translations.literal: On guisi day, made Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji head the Southern and Northern Privy Councils.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji was made head of the Southern and Northern Privy Councils.

sentences.zh: 乙未，阻卜長豁得剌弟斡得來朝，加太尉遣之。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Zubu chief Huedela's younger brother Wodelai came to court and was promoted Grand Master of War before being sent away.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Zubu chief Huedela's younger brother Wodelai came to court, was promoted Grand Master of War, and was sent away.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，錄囚。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以左夷離畢蕭唐古為北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: On wushen day, made Left yilibi Xiao Tanggu Northern Court associate privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Left yilibi Xiao Tanggu was made Northern Court associate privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬子，獵侯裏吉。

translations.literal: On renzi day, hunted at Houliji.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the court hunted at Houliji.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，阻卜酋長喘只葛拔裏斯來朝。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on dingmao day, Zubu chieftain Chuanzhige Balisi came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the eighth month Zubu chieftain Chuanzhige Balisi came to court.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，夏人侵邊，敵魯古遣六院軍將海裏擊敗之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renyin day, Xia troops invaded the border; Dilugu dispatched Six Courts general Haili and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day of the ninth month Xia troops invaded the border; Dilugu dispatched Six Courts general Haili and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，還上京。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengwu day, returned to the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day of the tenth winter month the court returned to the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 辛未，夏國王李諒祚母遣使乞依舊稱藩。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Li Liangzuo's mother in Xia State dispatched envoys begging to resume vassal status as before.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Li Liangzuo's mother in Xia State sent envoys begging to resume vassal status as before.

sentences.zh: 使還，詔諭別遣信臣詣闕，當徐思之。

translations.literal: When the envoys returned, an edict instructed them to send another trusted minister to the court separately; the matter would be considered at leisure.
translations.idiomatic: When the envoys returned, an edict instructed them to send another trusted minister to the court separately; the matter would be considered at leisure.

sentences.zh: 壬申，釋臨潢府役徒。

translations.literal: On renshen day, released convict laborers of Linhuang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day convict laborers of Linhuang Prefecture were released.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，如中會川。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, went to Zhonghuichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the court went to Zhonghuichuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，阻卜酋長豁得剌遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu day, Zubu chieftain Huedela dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day of the eleventh month Zubu chieftain Huedela sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，錄囚。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，出南府宰相韓知白為武定軍節度使，樞密副使楊績長寧軍節度使，翰林學士王綱澤州刺史，張宥徽州刺史，知制誥周白海北州刺史。

translations.literal: On renzi day, dismissed Southern Court chancellor Han Zhibai as Wuding Army military commissioner, associate privy commissioner Yang Ji as Changning Army military commissioner, Hanlin academician Wang Gang as prefect of Ze, Zhang You as prefect of Hui, and drafting edict commissioner Zhou Bai as prefect of Haibei.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Southern Court chancellor Han Zhibai was dismissed as Wuding Army military commissioner, associate privy commissioner Yang Ji as Changning Army military commissioner, Hanlin academician Wang Gang as prefect of Ze, Zhang You as prefect of Hui, and drafting edict commissioner Zhou Bai as prefect of Haibei.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙卯，以漢王貼不為中京留守。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on yimao day, made Prince of Han Tiebu regent of the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yimao day, Prince of Han Tiebu was made regent of the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以同知北院樞密使事蕭革為南院樞密使，南院大王耶律仁先知北院樞密使事，封宋王。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, made associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge Southern Court privy commissioner, Southern Court great king Yelü Renxian to administer Northern Court privy affairs, and enfeoffed him Prince of Song.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge was made Southern Court privy commissioner; Southern Court great king Yelü Renxian was appointed to administer Northern Court privy affairs and enfeoffed Prince of Song.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，北府宰相、趙王蕭孝友出為東京留守，東京留守蕭塔列葛為北府宰相，南院樞密使、潞王查葛為南院大王。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dinghai day, Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou was dismissed as Eastern Capital regent; Eastern Capital regent Xiao Taliege became Northern Court chancellor; Southern Court privy commissioner and Prince of Lu Chage became Southern Court great king.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day of the twelfth month Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou was dismissed as Eastern Capital regent; Eastern Capital regent Xiao Taliege became Northern Court chancellor; Southern Court privy commissioner and Prince of Lu Chage became Southern Court great king.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，韓國王蕭惠徙封魏王，致仕。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Prince of Han Xiao Hui was transferred to Prince of Wei and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Prince of Han Xiao Hui was transferred to Prince of Wei and retired.

sentences.zh: 壬子，夏國李諒祚遣使上表，乞依舊臣屬。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys presenting a memorial begging to resume subject status as before.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys presenting a memorial begging to resume subject status as before.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月戊戌，駐蹕混同江。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, spring, first month, on wuxu day, halted at the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, on wuxu day of the first spring month the court halted at the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，遣前北院都監蕭友括等使夏國，索党項叛戶。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiashen day, dispatched former Northern Court inspector-general Xiao Youkuo and others as envoys to Xia State to demand Tangut rebel households.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day of the second month former Northern Court inspector-general Xiao Youkuo and others were dispatched as envoys to Xia State to demand Tangut rebel households.

sentences.zh: 己丑，如蒼耳濼。

translations.literal: On jichou day, went to Canger Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the court went to Canger Marsh.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，吐蕃遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子朔，幸黑水。

translations.literal: Third month, on renzi new moon, visited Heishui.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the third month the court visited Heishui.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸丑，蕭友括等使夏還，李諒祚母表乞如党項權進馬、駝、牛、羊等物。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, on guichou day, Xiao Youkuo and others returned from Xia; Li Liangzuo's mother memorialized begging to present horses, camels, cattle, and sheep as Tangut custom allowed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day of the fifth summer month Xiao Youkuo and others returned from Xia; Li Liangzuo's mother memorialized begging to present horses, camels, cattle, and sheep as Tangut custom allowed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，夏國遣使求唐隆鎮及乞罷所建城邑，以詔答之。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Xia State dispatched envoys requesting Tanglong Post and begging to abandon fortified towns they had built; answered by edict.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Xia State sent envoys requesting Tanglong Post and begging to abandon fortified towns they had built; the court answered by edict.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，詔以所獲李元昊妻及前後所俘夏人，安置蘇州。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingxu day, edict ordered Li Yuanhao's wife captured earlier and Xia people captured before and after to be settled in Su Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the sixth month an edict ordered Li Yuanhao's wife captured earlier and Xia people captured before and after to be settled in Su Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以伐夏所獲物遣使遺宋。

translations.literal: Goods captured in the Xia campaign were sent by envoys as gifts to Song.
translations.idiomatic: Goods captured in the Xia campaign were sent by envoys as gifts to Song.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，如秋山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, went to autumn mountains.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔更定條制。

translations.literal: Ninth month, edict ordered regulations to be revised anew.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month an edict ordered regulations to be revised anew.

sentences.zh: 駐蹕中會川。

translations.literal: Halted at Zhonghuichuan.
translations.idiomatic: The court halted at Zhonghuichuan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯朔，括諸道軍籍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jimao new moon, registered military rolls in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the tenth winter month military rolls in all circuits were registered.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，以惕隱都監蕭謨魯為左夷離畢。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on gengshen day, made tiyin inspector-general Xiao Molu Left yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day of the eleventh month tiyin inspector-general Xiao Molu was made Left yilibi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命東京留守司總領戶部、內省事。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, ordered the Eastern Capital regent's office to oversee Household and Inner Court affairs in general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Eastern Capital regent's office was ordered to oversee Household and Inner Court affairs in general.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，罷中丞記錄職官過犯，令承旨總之。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, abolished the censor's office of recording officials' offenses; ordered drafting edict commissioners to oversee it in general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the censor's office of recording officials' offenses was abolished; drafting edict commissioners were ordered to oversee it in general.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，以皇太后行再生禮，肆赦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on yiyou day, because the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth ritual, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the twelfth month, because the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth ritual, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月辛亥，如混同江。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, spring, first month, on xinhai day, went to the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, on xinhai day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 二月，如魚兒濼。

translations.literal: Second month, went to Yuer Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the court went to Yuer Marsh.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，以國舅詳穩蕭阿剌為西北路招討使，封西平郡王。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guimao day, made imperial maternal uncle detail-stable Xiao Ala Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed him Prince of Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day of the fourth summer month imperial maternal uncle detail-stable Xiao Ala was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，駐蹕永安山。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingzi day, halted at Yongan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the sixth month the court halted at Yongan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰朔，召北府宰相蕭塔烈葛、南府宰相漢王貼不、南院樞密使蕭革、知北院樞密使事仁先等，賜坐，論古今治道。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiachen new moon, summoned Northern Court chancellor Xiao Taliege, Southern Court chancellor Prince of Han Tiebu, Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge, and Renxian, who administered Northern Court privy affairs; granted them seats and discussed the ways of governing ancient and modern times.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen new moon of the seventh autumn month Northern Court chancellor Xiao Taliege, Southern Court chancellor Prince of Han Tiebu, Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge, and Renxian, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, were summoned; they were granted seats and discussed the ways of governing ancient and modern times.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祀天地。

translations.literal: On wushen day, sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔北、南樞密院，日再奏事。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, edict ordered the Northern and Southern Privy Councils to memorialize twice daily.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict ordered the Northern and Southern Privy Councils to memorialize twice daily.

sentences.zh: 壬子，追尊太祖之祖為簡獻皇帝，廟號玄祖，祖妣為簡獻皇后；

translations.literal: On renzi day, posthumously honored Taizu's grandfather as Emperor Jianxian, temple name Xuanzu, and his grandmother as Empress Jianxian;
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Taizu's grandfather was posthumously honored as Emperor Jianxian, temple name Xuanzu, and his grandmother as Empress Jianxian;

sentences.zh: 太祖之考為宣簡皇帝，廟號德祖，妣為宣簡皇后。

translations.literal: Taizu's father as Emperor Xuanjian, temple name Dezu, and his mother as Empress Xuanjian.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu's father was honored as Emperor Xuanjian, temple name Dezu, and his mother as Empress Xuanjian.

sentences.zh: 追封太祖伯父夷離堇巖木為蜀國王，於越釋魯為隋國王。

translations.literal: Posthumously enfeoffed Taizu's paternal uncle yilijin Yanmu as Prince of Shu and yuyue Shilu as Prince of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu's paternal uncle yilijin Yanmu was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Shu and yuyue Shilu Prince of Sui.

sentences.zh: 以燕趙國王洪基為天下兵馬大元帥、知惕隱事，賜詔諭之。

translations.literal: Made Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven and administrator of tiyin affairs, and granted him an edict of instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji was made grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven and administrator of tiyin affairs, and granted an edict of instruction.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，近侍小底盧寶偽學御書，免死，配役終身。

translations.literal: On guihai day, attendant junior attendant Lu Baofei forged the imperial hand; death was remitted and he was sentenced to corvée for life.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day attendant junior attendant Lu Baofei forged the imperial hand; death was remitted and he was sentenced to corvée for life.

sentences.zh: 甲子，如秋山。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, went to autumn mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the court went to autumn mountains.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，謁慶陵。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 以南院樞密使蕭革為北院樞密使，封吳王。

translations.literal: Made Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge Northern Court privy commissioner and enfeoffed him Prince of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge was made Northern Court privy commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Wu.

sentences.zh: 辛未，如慶州。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, went to Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the court went to Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，追封太祖弟寅底石為許國王。

translations.literal: On renshen day, posthumously enfeoffed Taizu's younger brother Yindishi as Prince of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Taizu's younger brother Yindishi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xu.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，太尉烏者薨，詔配享聖宗廟。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on wuzi day, Grand Master of War Wuzhe died; edict ordered him to share sacrifice in Shengzong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the eighth month Grand Master of War Wuzhe died; an edict ordered him to share sacrifice in Shengzong's temple.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，平州進白兔。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yimao day, Ping Prefecture presented a white hare.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the ninth month Ping Prefecture presented a white hare.

sentences.zh: 己未，謁懷陵。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the court paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 庚申，追上嗣聖皇帝、天順皇帝尊謚，及更謚彰德皇后曰靖安。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, posthumously advanced honorific titles for the Shangsi Sage Emperor and the Tianshun Emperor, and changed Empress Zhangde's posthumous title to Jing'an.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day honorific titles were posthumously advanced for the Shangsi Sage Emperor and the Tianshun Emperor, and Empress Zhangde's posthumous title was changed to Jing'an.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，謚齊天皇后曰仁德皇后。

translations.literal: On guihai day, posthumous title for Empress Qitian was changed to Empress Rende.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the posthumous title for Empress Qitian was changed to Empress Rende.

sentences.zh: 甲子，謁祖陵。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the court paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 增太祖謚大聖大明神烈天皇帝，更謚貞烈皇后曰淳欽，恭順皇帝曰章肅，后蕭氏謚曰和敬。

translations.literal: Taizu's honorific was increased to Great Sage, Great Brightness, Divine Martyr, Heavenly Emperor; Empress Zhenlie's title was changed to Chunqin; Emperor Gongshun to Zhangsu; Empress Xiao's title to Hejing.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu's honorific was increased to Great Sage, Great Brightness, Divine Martyr, Heavenly Emperor; Empress Zhenlie's title was changed to Chunqin; Emperor Gongshun to Zhangsu; and Empress Xiao's title to Hejing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，駐蹕中會川。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuyin day, halted at Zhonghuichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Zhonghuichuan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，夏國李諒祚遣使乞弛邊備，即遣蕭友括奉詔諭之。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys begging relaxation of border defenses; immediately dispatched Xiao Youkuo to convey the edict of instruction.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys begging relaxation of border defenses; Xiao Youkuo was immediately dispatched to convey the edict of instruction.

sentences.zh: 戊子，幸顯、懿二州。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, visited Xian and Yi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the court visited Xian and Yi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遼興軍節度使蕭虛烈封鄭王，南院大王、潞王查葛為南院樞密使，進封越國王。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie was enfeoffed Prince of Zheng; Southern Court great king and Prince of Lu Chage was made Southern Court privy commissioner and advanced to Prince of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie was enfeoffed Prince of Zheng; Southern Court great king and Prince of Lu Chage was made Southern Court privy commissioner and advanced to Prince of Yue.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，射虎於南撒葛柏。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, shot tigers at Nansagebo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day tigers were shot at Nansagebo.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，謁乾陵。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅朔，增謚文獻皇帝為文獻欽義皇帝，及謚二后曰端順，曰柔貞。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renyin new moon, advanced Emperor Wenxian's honorific to Emperor Wenxian, Qinyi, and posthumous titles for the two empresses to Duanshun and Rouzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the eleventh month Emperor Wenxian's honorific was advanced to Emperor Wenxian, Qinyi, and posthumous titles for the two empresses to Duanshun and Rouzhen.

sentences.zh: 復更謚世宗孝烈皇后為懷節。

translations.literal: Again changed Shizong's Empress Xiaolie posthumous title to Huaijie.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong's Empress Xiaolie posthumous title was again changed to Huaijie.

sentences.zh: 丁未，增孝成皇帝謚曰孝成康靖皇帝，更謚聖神宣獻皇后為睿智。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, advanced Emperor Xiaocheng's honorific to Emperor Xiaocheng, Kangjing, and changed Empress Shengshen, Xuanxian posthumous title to Ruizhi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Emperor Xiaocheng's honorific was advanced to Emperor Xiaocheng, Kangjing, and Empress Shengshen, Xuanxian posthumous title was changed to Ruizhi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，次中會川。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, halted at Zhonghuichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the court halted at Zhonghuichuan.

sentences.zh: 回鶻阿薩蘭遣使貢名馬、文豹。

translations.literal: Uighur Asalan dispatched envoys presenting famous horses and literary leopards.
translations.idiomatic: Uighur Asalan sent envoys presenting famous horses and literary leopards.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，錄囚。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，以北府宰相塔烈葛為南京統軍使，鄭王虛烈北府宰相，契丹行宮都部署耶律義先惕隱。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on wuxu day, made Northern Court chancellor Taliege Nanjing supreme commander, Prince of Zheng Xulie Northern Court chancellor, and Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Yixian tiyin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day of the twelfth month Northern Court chancellor Taliege was made Nanjing supreme commander, Prince of Zheng Xulie Northern Court chancellor, and Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Yixian tiyin.

sentences.zh: 釋役徒限年者。

translations.literal: Released convict laborers whose term limit had expired.
translations.idiomatic: Convict laborers whose term limit had expired were released.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月乙巳，如混同江。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, spring, first month, on yisi day, went to the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, on yisi day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，回鶻阿薩蘭為鄰國所侵，遣使求援。

translations.literal: Second month, on bingzi day, Uighur Asalan was invaded by a neighboring state and dispatched envoys seeking aid.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the second month Uighur Asalan was invaded by a neighboring state and sent envoys seeking aid.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，如春水。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, went to spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the court went to spring waters.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，李諒祚以賜詔許降，遣使來謝。

translations.literal: Third month, on guihai day, Li Liangzuo, because the granted edict permitted surrender, dispatched envoys to give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the third month Li Liangzuo, because the granted edict permitted surrender, sent envoys to give thanks.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，如黑水濼。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, went to Heishui Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the court went to Heishui Marsh.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuzi day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the fourth summer month

sentences.zh: 獵鶴澱。

translations.literal: Hunted at Hedan.
translations.idiomatic: the court hunted at Hedan.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，詔內地州縣植果。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on renyin day, edict ordered inland prefectures and counties to plant fruit trees.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day of the fifth month an edict ordered inland prefectures and counties to plant fruit trees.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，駐蹕胡呂山。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renshen day, halted at Hulü Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the sixth month the court halted at Hulü Mountain.

sentences.zh: 癸未，高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，阻卜大王屯禿古斯率諸部長獻馬、駝。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiyou day, Zubu great king Tutugu led various tribal chiefs presenting horses and camels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day of the seventh autumn month Zubu great king Tutugu led various tribal chiefs presenting horses and camels.

sentences.zh: 庚申，如黑嶺。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, went to Heiling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the court went to Heiling.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚午，烏古來貢。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on gengwu day, Wugu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengwu day, Wugu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，長春州置錢帛司。

translations.literal: On guisi day, established the Money and Silks Office at Changchun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Money and Silks Office was established at Changchun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，夏國李諒祚遣使進降表。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renchen day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys presenting a surrender memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the ninth month Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys presenting a surrender memorial.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣南面林牙高家奴等奉詔撫諭。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, dispatched Southern Court linya Gaojianu and others to convey the edict and offer reassurance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Southern Court linya Gaojianu and others were dispatched to convey the edict and offer reassurance.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingshen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen new moon of the tenth winter month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，詔諸職事官以禮受代及以罪去者置籍，歲申樞密院。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on xinmao day, edict ordered that when officials of all posts received successors by ritual or left office for crimes, registers were to be kept and reported yearly to the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day of the eleventh month an edict ordered that when officials of all posts received successors by ritual or left office for crimes, registers were to be kept and reported yearly to the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申朔，詔回鶻部副使以契丹人充。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on bingchen new moon, edict ordered Uighur tribal deputy commissioners to be filled by Khitan persons.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the twelfth month an edict ordered Uighur tribal deputy commissioners to be filled by Khitan persons.

sentences.zh: 庚子，應聖節，曲赦徒以下罪。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the Responding Sage Festival; partial amnesty for offenses at or below convict labor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Responding Sage Festival, a partial amnesty was granted for offenses at or below convict labor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔大臣曰：「朕與宋主約為兄弟，歡好歲久，欲見其繪像，可諭來使。」

translations.literal: On renzi day, edict to great ministers said: "I and the Song ruler are pledged as brothers; our friendship has lasted many years. I wish to see his painted likeness; you may instruct the incoming envoys."
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict to great ministers said: "I and the Song ruler are pledged as brothers; our friendship has lasted many years. I wish to see his painted likeness; you may instruct the incoming envoys."

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月己巳，如混同江。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, spring, first month, on jisi day, went to the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, on jisi day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，獵雙子澱。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, hunted at Shuangzi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the court hunted at Shuangzi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 戊子，夏國遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Xia State sent envoys with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，如春水。

translations.literal: On renchen day, went to spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the court went to spring waters.

sentences.zh: 甲午，獵盤直坡。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, hunted at Panzhipo.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the court hunted at Panzhipo.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，幸皇太弟重元帳。

translations.literal: Third month, on dinghai day, visited the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan's tent.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day of the third month the court visited the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan's tent.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guimao day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day of the fourth summer month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，獵合只忽裏。

translations.literal: On guichou day, hunted at Hezhihuli.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the court hunted at Hezhihuli.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，李諒祚乞進馬、駝，詔歲貢之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jisi day, Li Liangzuo begged to present horses and camels; edict ordered yearly tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day of the fifth month Li Liangzuo begged to present horses and camels; an edict ordered yearly tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，駐蹕永安山。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, halted at Yongan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the court halted at Yongan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，夏國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，如慶州。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingshen day, went to Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day of the sixth month the court went to Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，謁慶陵。

translations.literal: On yihai day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，高麗王徽請官其子，詔加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Goryeo king Hui requested official rank for his son; edict ordered promotion to acting Grand Master of War.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Goryeo king Hui requested official rank for his son; an edict ordered promotion to acting Grand Master of War.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，吐蕃遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，夏國李諒祚遣使來求婚。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jisi day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys to seek marriage.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day of the seventh autumn month Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys to seek marriage.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，如秋山。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, went to autumn mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the court went to autumn mountains.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔八房族巾幘。

translations.literal: On jimao day, edict ordered the eight house-clans to wear headcloths.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day an edict ordered the eight house-clans to wear headcloths.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，獵，遇三虎，縱犬獲之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengyin day, hunted; encountering three tigers, released dogs and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day of the ninth month the court hunted; encountering three tigers, dogs were released and they were captured.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，駐蹕中京。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingyou day, halted at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day of the tenth winter month the court halted at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，幸新建秘書監。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, visited the newly built Directorate of the Imperial Library.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the court visited the newly built Directorate of the Imperial Library.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，有事於祖廟。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, performed rites at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day rites were performed at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以開泰寺鑄銀佛像，曲赦在京囚。

translations.literal: On guichou day, because silver Buddha images were cast at Kaitai Temple, a partial amnesty for prisoners in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, because silver Buddha images were cast at Kaitai Temple, a partial amnesty was granted for prisoners in the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，李諒祚遣使進誓表。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys presenting an oath memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Li Liangzuo sent envoys presenting an oath memorial.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，阻卜部長來貢。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yichou day, Zubu tribal chiefs came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day of the eleventh month Zubu tribal chiefs came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬申，帝率群臣上皇太后尊號曰仁慈聖善欽孝廣德安靜貞純懿和寬厚崇覺儀天皇太后，大赦。

translations.literal: On renshen day, the Emperor led the ministers in presenting the Empress Dowager the honorific title Benevolent, Sagely, Pious, Filial, Broadly Virtuous, Tranquil, Pure, Gracious, Harmonious, Generous, Reverent, Awakened, Ceremonious, Heavenly Empress Dowager, and proclaimed a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Emperor led the ministers in presenting the Empress Dowager the honorific title Benevolent, Sagely, Pious, Filial, Broadly Virtuous, Tranquil, Pure, Gracious, Harmonious, Generous, Reverent, Awakened, Ceremonious, Heavenly Empress Dowager, and proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 內外官進級有差。

translations.literal: Inner and outer officials advanced in rank by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Inner and outer officials advanced in rank by degree.

sentences.zh: 癸未，錄囚。

translations.literal: On guimao day, reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，群臣上皇帝尊號曰欽天奉道佑世興歷武定文成聖神仁孝皇帝，冊皇后蕭氏曰貞懿慈和文惠孝敬廣愛崇聖皇后。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the ministers presented the Emperor the honorific title Revering Heaven, Upholding the Way, Protecting the Age, Raising the Calendar, Martially Settling, Literaryly Accomplished, Sagely, Spiritually Benevolent, Filial Emperor, and invested Empress Xiao with the title Chaste, Gracious, Kind, Harmonious, Cultured, Favorable, Reverent, Filial, Broadly Loving, Chong, Sagely Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the ministers presented the Emperor the honorific title Revering Heaven, Upholding the Way, Protecting the Age, Raising the Calendar, Martially Settling, Literaryly Accomplished, Sagely, Spiritually Benevolent, Filial Emperor, and invested Empress Xiao with the title Chaste, Gracious, Kind, Harmonious, Cultured, Favorable, Reverent, Filial, Broadly Loving, Chong, Sagely Empress.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，如中會川。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on bingshen day, went to Zhonghuichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day of the twelfth month the court went to Zhonghuichuan.
